title: How the screening room is built
question: Safer register, fresh hand — every earlier structure is off the table. The roll led with The Record. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Record
options.lineage: the patient chart — the file is the home, the visit is an event in it
options.thesis: Your recovery record is the surface; a screening is something you start from inside it.
options.viewport: Your symptom and convergence trend since the injury, a single Start screening action beside it, and every past session dated below.
options.case: You use this for weeks, not once, and it holds a healthy baseline to compare against — so the record, not the test, is the thing you actually return to.
options.risk: On day one the record is empty, and an empty chart is a bleak first thing to hand someone who just got hurt.

options.label: Runner and Review
options.lineage: the standard multi-step flow with a review step before you submit
options.thesis: Run the seven tasks in order, then land on a review where any task can be redone before anything is recorded.
options.viewport: One task on stage with its rating directly beneath, and a strip of all seven along the bottom showing which are done.
options.case: The most familiar pattern in software, and the review step is the honest answer to a task performed badly because symptoms spiked mid-way.
options.risk: The bottom strip is seven things in permanent peripheral view, which is seven things competing with the target.

options.label: Protocol Checklist
options.lineage: the clinical protocol sheet a examiner works down
options.thesis: The seven tasks stand as a checklist you work down and can leave at any point, with the active one open beside it.
options.viewport: Seven named tasks down the left with their state, the one you are on open and quiet on the right.
options.case: Stopping partway is an expected outcome here, not an error — a checklist is the one structure where quitting at task four still leaves something coherent and resumable.
options.risk: Seeing all seven at once can read as a workload at the exact moment concentration is the scarce resource.
